changeSet.sql: UPDATE public.utm_configuration_parameter SET conf_param_required = false, conf_param_regexp = '^$|^(\s*[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+(\s*,\s*[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+)*\s*|\s*[\w.-]+@[\w.-]+\.\w+\s*)$' WHERE section_id = 4 AND conf_param_short IN ('utmstack.alert.addressToNotifyAlerts', 'utmstack.alert.addressToNotifyIncidents');
